name: Annihilator
author: blackdiamondgamedev
description:
​Annihilator, is a game where you are trapped in a planet called T131 and you have to kill all the Zyrus Robots and ESCAPE!

Story​ - (It was year 2099 in Earth) You and your team were going in a spaceship to T131 planet for research work when suddenly a meteorite hits your spaceship. The meteorite creates a big hole in the spaceship. You were the only one wearing the spacesuit so you survive but your team gets lost in the space forever! You're some teammates land on the planet but the Zyrus Robots kill them! . You wake up and find yourself in a planet, when you see your spacesuit GPS, you find out you are in T131 planet. You find out that this planet is conquered and ruled by Zyrus robots. Disclaimer - Zyrus Robots are robots who have many leaders. They are strong and almost like robots. They're found in Kepler planet.
You just have a plasma gun. You have to kill them all and survive!

This name 'Annihilator' was given by my best friend Yashovardhan Reddy. Thx Yashovardhan!😊
